claims.text: All 26 fixed plan indices have at most one native attempt; censored, failed, unsupported and interrupted cells remain in the denominator. This is a natural prime n23 F4 block, not an inference about other generators or keys.

A completed F4 cell retains its bounded affine S3-chain system, native visitor and group-lift trace, and independent verifier outcome. A budget, timeout or degree stop does not certify no decomposition or an exact first or last fall degree.
An ECDLP scalar label is promoted only after native independent recovery and generator-target group replay; a known-answer scalar or PDP witness alone does not qualify.
Each attempted shard retains native verify, report and strict export statuses, a restricted archive and fresh S3 archive and pointer readback receipts; failures remain counted.

negative.not_applicable_reason: A recomputed-hash tampered F4 witness fixture must be rejected by the native verifier before natural cells; this exact fixed-population study makes no false-positive-rate inference.

positive.not_applicable_reason: A separate fixed known-positive F4 fixture must pass the same native verification path before natural cells; fixture results are outside this 26-cell denominator and no detector-sensitivity claim is made.
